description: Na₂Li₃FeO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnnm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with eight LiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with five LiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 19°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.76 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with ten LiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with four LiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.61 Å. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four LiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with three NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two LiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-54°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.08 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with three NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-80°. There are two shorter (1.90 Å) and two longer (2.11 Å) Li-O bond lengths. Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, corners with six LiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with three NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with three LiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-81°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-1.93 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to three Na, three Li, and one Fe atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to three Na, three Li, and one Fe atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to three Na, three Li, and one Fe atom.
